rows.source_ko: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this ruleis to prescribe matters delegated by the Buildings Management Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act , and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.
rows.text_en: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Rule is to prescribe matters delegated by the Buildings Management Act and the Enforcement Decree of the same Act, and matters necessary for the implementation thereof.

rows.source_ko: Article 2 (Method of Fact-finding Survey, etc.) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district, hereinafter the same) may conduct a fact-finding survey regarding the matters in each of the following subparagraphs pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Building Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”).
rows.text_en: Article 2 (Method of Fact-finding Survey, etc.) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (referring to the head of a self-governing district, hereinafter the same) may conduct a fact-finding survey regarding the matters in each of the following subparagraphs pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Building Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”).

rows.source_ko: 1. Status of establishment of building management plans pursuant to Article 11 of the Act
rows.text_en: 1. Status of establishment of building management plans pursuant to Article 11 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. Status of maintenance of vacant buildings pursuant to Article 42 of the Act
rows.text_en: 2. Status of maintenance of vacant buildings pursuant to Article 42 of the Act

rows.source_ko: ② The survey of actual conditions pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act may be conducted by statistical surveys, literature surveys, or field surveys, or by using information and communication networks and electronic mail, etc.
rows.text_en: ② The survey of actual conditions pursuant to Article 6, Paragraph 1 of the Act may be conducted by statistical surveys, literature surveys, or field surveys, or by using information and communication networks and electronic mail, etc.

rows.source_ko: Article 3 (Procedures for Requesting and Method of Submission of Building Lifecycle Information, etc.) ① When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport requests the provision of data or information pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he or she shall notify the person who possesses or manages the relevant data or information of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. In this case, the deadline for submission shall be determined by considering a period of at least 15 days for the submission.
rows.text_en: Article 3 (Procedures for Requesting and Method of Submission of Building Lifecycle Information, etc.) ① When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport requests the provision of data or information pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he or she shall notify the person who possesses or manages the relevant data or information of the matters set forth in each of the following subparagraphs. In this case, the deadline for submission shall be determined by considering a period of at least 15 days for the submission.

rows.source_ko: 1. Reason for request for submission
rows.text_en: 1. Reason for request for submission

rows.source_ko: 2. Submission Deadline
rows.text_en: 2. Submission Deadline

rows.source_ko: 3. Specific details of the requested materials or information

rows.source_ko: 4. Submission Method
rows.text_en: 4. Submission Method

rows.source_ko: 5. Plan for the utilization of submitted materials or information

rows.source_ko: ② Any person who has been requested to provide data or information pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall submit it through the building lifecycle information system pursuant to Article 7 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “building lifecycle information system”).
rows.text_en: ② Any person who has been requested to provide data or information pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall submit it through the building lifecycle information system pursuant to Article 7 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “building lifecycle information system”).

rows.source_ko: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, necessary matters concerning the method of requesting data or information and the procedure for submission, etc. pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport .
rows.text_en: ③ In addition to the matters prescribed in Paragraphs 1 and 2, necessary matters concerning the method of requesting data or information and the procedure for submission, etc. pursuant to Article 7, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport .

rows.source_ko: Article 5 (Adjustment of Building Management Plan) ① If a manager intends to adjust a building management plan pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 5 of the Act , the adjustment plan shall be entered into the building lifecycle information system.
rows.text_en: Article 5 (Adjustment of Building Management Plan) ① If a manager intends to adjust a building management plan pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 5 of the Act , the adjustment plan shall be entered into the building lifecycle information system.

rows.source_ko: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head shall review the appropriateness of the adjustment plan entered pursuant to Paragraph 1 and register the results of the review in the Building Lifecycle Information System.
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head shall review the appropriateness of the adjustment plan entered pursuant to Paragraph 1 and register the results of the review in the Building Lifecycle Information System.

rows.source_ko: 제6조(건축물 주요 부분의 수선ㆍ변경ㆍ증설) 관리자는 「건축법」 제2조제1항제7호에 따른 주요구조부에 대해 같은 법 제11조 또는 제14조에 따라 건축허가를 받거나 건축신고를 하고 수선ㆍ변경하거나 증설하는 경우 법 제11조제6항에 따라 이를 완료한 날부터 30일 이내에 그 결과를 건축물 생애이력 정보체계에 입력해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 6 (Repair, Alteration, or Expansion of Major Parts of a Building) Where a manager repairs, alters, or expands a major structural part pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1, Item 7 of the Building Act after obtaining a building permit or filing a building report pursuant to Article 11 or Article 14 of the same Act, the manager shall input the results into the building lifecycle information system within 30 days from the date of completion pursuant to Article 11, Paragraph 6 of the Act.

rows.source_ko: 제7조(정기점검 등의 통지) ① 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 법 제19조제1항에 따라 관리자에게 점검 대상 건축물이라는 사실과 점검 실시절차를 통지하는 경우 「건축물관리법 시행령」(이하 “영”이라 한다) 제12조제4항에 따라 지정된 건축물관리점검기관을 알려 주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 7 (Notification of Periodic Inspection, etc.) ① When a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or Mayor, County Head, or District Head notifies a manager of the fact that a building is subject to inspection and the procedure for conducting the inspection pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they shall provide information on the building management inspection agency designated pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree of the Building Management Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Decree”).

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제19조제1항에 따른 점검의 통지는 문서, 팩스, 전자우편 또는 문자메시지 등으로 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② Notification of inspection pursuant to Article 19, Paragraph 1 of the Act may be made by document, fax, email, or text message, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제8조(조치결과의 보고) 관리자는 법 제23조제1항에 따라 법 제22조제1항 및 제2항에 따른 조치를 완료한 날부터 30일 이내에 해당 조치결과를 건축물 생애이력 정보체계에 입력하는 방법으로 보고해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 8 (Reporting of Measures) In accordance with Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the manager shall report the results of the measures taken within 30 days from the date of completion of the measures taken pursuant to Article 22 , Paragraphs 1 and 2 of the Act by entering them into the building lifecycle information system.

rows.source_ko: 제9조(기존 건축물의 화재안전성능보강에 대한 이의신청) ① 법 제27조제3항 후단에 따라 이의신청을 하려는 자는 별지 제2호서식의 화재안전성능보강 이의신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 9 (Objection to Reinforcement of Fire Safety Performance of Existing Buildings) ① Any person who intends to file an objection pursuant to the latter part of Article 27, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall submit the objection form for reinforcement of fire safety performance in Annex 2, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: 1. 화재안전성능보강 대상 건축물에서 제외되기를 요청하는 사유에 대한 근거자료
rows.text_en: 1. Supporting documents for the reasons requesting exclusion from buildings subject to fire safety performance reinforcement

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 건축물의 화재안전성능에 관한 근거자료
rows.text_en: 2. Supporting data regarding the fire safety performance of the relevant building

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 및 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제1항에 따라 이의신청을 받은 경우 「건축법」 제4조에 따른 건축위원회의 심의를 거쳐 해당 건축물을 화재안전성능보강 대상 건축물에서 제외할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If an objection is received pursuant to Paragraph 1, the mayor of a special self-governing city, the governor of a special self-governing province, or the mayor, county head, or district head may exclude the relevant building from the list of buildings subject to fire safety performance reinforcement after deliberation by the Architectural Committee pursuant to Article 4 of the Building Act .

rows.source_ko: 제10조(화재안전성능보강의 시행) ① 관리자는 법 제28조제1항에 따라 승인을 받으려는 경우 별지 제3호서식의 화재안전성능보강 계획 승인신청서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 10 (Implementation of Fire Safety Performance Reinforcement) ① If a manager intends to obtain approval pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they shall submit an application for approval of a fire safety performance reinforcement plan in the form of Annex 3, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: 1. 건축물 현황 도서
rows.text_en: 1. Building Status Documents

rows.source_ko: 2. 화재안전성능보강 예정 공사 설명서
rows.text_en: 2. Description of Planned Fire Safety Performance Reinforcement Construction

rows.source_ko: 3. 화재안전성능보강 예정 공사비 명세서
rows.text_en: 3. Specification of Estimated Construction Costs for Fire Safety Performance Reinforcement

rows.source_ko: ② 관리자는 법 제28조제3항에 따라 화재안전성능보강 결과를 보고하려는 경우 별지 제4호서식의 화재안전성능보강 결과 보고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② If the manager intends to report the results of fire safety performance reinforcement pursuant to Article 28, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall submit the report on the results of fire safety performance reinforcement in the form of Annex 4, along with the documents listed in each of the following subparagraphs, to the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head.

rows.source_ko: 1. 화재안전성능보강 전후 도면
rows.text_en: 1. Drawings of Fire Safety Performance Reinforcement Before and After

rows.source_ko: 2. 화재안전성능보강 공사 설명서
rows.text_en: 2. Fire Safety Performance Reinforcement Construction Specifications

rows.source_ko: 3. 화재안전성능보강 공사비 명세서
rows.text_en: 3. Specification of Construction Costs for Fire Safety Performance Reinforcement

rows.source_ko: 제4장 건축물의 해체 및 멸실
rows.text_en: Chapter 4 Demolition and Destruction of Buildings

rows.source_ko: 제11조(건축물 해체의 허가 신청 등) ① 법 제30조제3항에 따른 건축물 해체 허가신청서는 별지 제5호서식에 따른다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 11 (Application for Permission for Demolition of Buildings, etc.) ①The application form for permission to demolish a building pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall be in accordance with Form No. 5 of the Attached Form . <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장(이하 “허가권자”라 한다)은 법 제30조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 본문 및 같은 조 제2항에 따라 허가를 한 경우에는 같은 조 제3항에 따라 허가를 신청한 자에게 별지 제6호서식의 건축물 해체 허가서를 내주어야 한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: ② In cases where a permit has been granted pursuant to the main text of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 30 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Paragraph 2 of the same Act, the Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Head, or District Head (hereinafter referred to as the “Permit Authority”) shall issue a building demolition permit in the form of Annex 6 to the person who applied for the permit pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Act . <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제21조제2항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 신고서”란 별지 제5호서식의 건축물 해체 신고서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 21 , Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree, “report form prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the building demolition report form in Annex 5 .

rows.source_ko: ④ 허가권자는 법 제30조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 단서에 따른 신고를 수리하는 경우에는 같은 조 제3항에 따라 신고한 자에게 별지 제6호의2서식의 건축물 해체신고 확인증을 내주어야 한다. <신설 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: ④ In cases where the licensing authority accepts a report pursuant to the proviso of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 30, Paragraph 1 of the Act , it shall issue a Certificate of Confirmation of Building Demolition Report in the form of Annex 6-2 to the person who filed the report pursuant to Paragraph 3 of the same Article . <Newly added Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 관리자는 법 제30조제3항에 따른 건축물 해체 허가신청서 또는 신고서를 「건축법」 제11조 또는 제14조에 따라 건축허가를 신청하거나 건축신고를 할 때 함께 제출(전자문서로 제출하는 것을 포함한다)할 수 있다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ The administrator may submit the application for a building demolition permit or the report pursuant to Article 30 , Paragraph 3 of the Act together (including submission as an electronic document) when applying for a building permit or filing a building report pursuant to Article 11 or 14 of the Building Act. < Amended Aug. 4 , 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제12조(해체계획서의 작성) ① 법 제30조제3항에 따른 해체계획서에는 다음 각 호의 내용이 포함되어야 한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 12 (Preparation of Demolition Plan) ① A demolition plan pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act shall include the contents of each of the following subparagraphs. <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해체공사의 공정 등 해체공사의 개요
rows.text_en: 1. Overview of Demolition Work, Process, etc.

rows.source_ko: 2. 해체공사의 영향을 받게 될 「건축법」 제2조제1항제4호에 따른 건축설비의 이동, 철거 및 보호 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 2. Matters concerning the movement, removal, and protection, etc. of building facilities pursuant to Article 2, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 of the Building Act that will be affected by the demolition work

rows.source_ko: 3. 해체공사의 작업순서, 해체공법 및 이에 따른 구조안전계획
rows.text_en: 3. Work sequence, demolition method, and corresponding structural safety plan for demolition work

rows.source_ko: 4. 해체공사 현장의 화재 방지대책, 공해 방지 방안, 교통안전 방안, 안전통로 확보 및 낙하 방지대책 등 안전관리대책
rows.text_en: 4. Safety management measures for the demolition site, including fire prevention measures, pollution prevention measures, traffic safety measures, securing safe passageways, and fall prevention measures

rows.source_ko: 5. 해체물의 처리계획
rows.text_en: 5. Disposal plan for demolished materials

rows.source_ko: 6. 해체공사 후 부지정리 및 인근 환경의 보수 및 보상 등에 관한 사항
rows.text_en: 6. Matters concerning site clearing, repair of the surrounding environment, and compensation, etc. after demolition work

rows.source_ko: ② 허가권자는 법 제30조제3항에 따라 제출받은 해체계획서에 보완이 필요하다고 인정하는 경우에는 기한을 정하여 보완을 요청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② If the licensing authority deems that supplementation is necessary for the dismantling plan submitted pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act , it may request supplementation by setting a deadline.

rows.source_ko: ③ 국토교통부장관은 제1항에 따른 해체계획서의 세부적인 작성 방법 등에 관해 필요한 사항을 정하여 고시해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport shall determine and announce necessary matters regarding the detailed method of preparing the demolition plan pursuant to Paragraph 1 .

rows.source_ko: 제12조의2(건축물 해체공사 착공신고) ① 관리자는 법 제30조의2제1항 본문에 따라 착공신고를 하려는 경우 별지 제6호의3서식의 건축물 해체공사 착공신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출(전자문서로 제출하는 것을 포함한다)해야 한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 12-2 (Notification of Commencement of Building Demolition Work) ① When a manager intends to report the commencement of work pursuant to the main clause of Article 30-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act, they shall submit the Notification of Commencement of Building Demolition Work in the form of Annex 6-3, along with the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs, to the licensing authority (including submission as an electronic document). <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해체공사계약서[해체공사를 수행하는 자(이하 “해체작업자”라 한다)가 해체공사를 하도급한 경우에는 하도급계약서를 포함한다] 사본
rows.text_en: 1. Copy of the demolition contract [including the subcontract agreement if the person performing the demolition work (hereinafter referred to as the “demolition worker”) has subcontracted the demolition work]

rows.source_ko: 2. 해체공사감리계약서 사본
rows.text_en: 2. Copy of Demolition Work Supervision Contract
3. Deleted <Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ② 허가권자는 제1항에 따른 건축물 해체공사 착공신고서를 제출받은 경우 다음 각 호의 사항에 대한 현장점검을 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving a report of commencement of building demolition work pursuant to Paragraph 1, the licensing authority shall conduct an on-site inspection regarding the matters in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 해체할 건축물의 현황
rows.text_en: 1. Current status of buildings to be demolished

rows.source_ko: 2. 해체할 건축물 주변의 도로 현황과 보행자 및 차량의 통행 현황
rows.text_en: 2. Current road conditions and pedestrian and vehicle traffic conditions around the building to be demolished

rows.source_ko: 3. 제12조제1항제4호에 따른 안전관리대책(착공신고 전에 이행할 수 있는 안전관리대책으로 한정한다)의 이행 여부
rows.text_en: 3. Whether safety management measures pursuant to Article 12, Paragraph 1, Subparagraph 4 (limited to safety management measures that can be implemented prior to the commencement of construction report) have been implemented

rows.source_ko: ③ 허가권자는 제2항에 따른 점검 결과 건축물의 안전한 해체를 위하여 보완이 필요하다고 인정되는 사항에 대하여 관리자에게 보완을 요구해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The licensing authority shall require the manager to supplement matters deemed necessary for the safe demolition of the building as a result of the inspection under Paragraph 2.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따른 보완을 요구받은 관리자는 특별한 사유가 없으면 요구에 따라야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ Any manager who is requested to supplement pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall comply with the request unless there is a special reason.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 허가권자는 제2항 및 제3항에 따른 점검 및 보완 결과 건축물 해체공사의 안전이 확보되었다고 인정되면 별지 제6호의4서식의 건축물 해체공사 착공신고 확인증을 관리자에게 내주어야 한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: ⑤ If the licensing authority recognizes that the safety of the building demolition work has been secured as a result of the inspection and supplementary measures pursuant to Paragraphs 2 and 3, it shall issue a Confirmation Certificate of Commencement of Building Demolition Work in the form of Annex 6-4 to the manager. <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>
[This Article Newly Inserted Oct. 28, 2021]

rows.source_ko: 제12조의3(허가ㆍ신고사항의 변경 등) ① 관리자는 법 제30조의3제1항에 따라 허가를 받았거나 신고한 사항 중 영 제21조의2제1항 각 호의 사항을 변경하려면 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 허가권자의 변경허가를 받거나 허가권자에게 변경신고를 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-3 (Change of Permitted or Reported Matters, etc.) ① If a manager intends to change any of the matters specified in each subparagraph of Article 21-2 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree among the matters for which permission has been obtained or reported pursuant to Article 30-3, Paragraph 1 of the Act , the manager must obtain permission for change from the licensing authority or report the change to the licensing authority in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 당초 건축물 해체허가를 받은 경우에는 변경허가를 받을 것
rows.text_en: 1. If a permit for the demolition of a building was originally obtained, a permit for modification must be obtained.

rows.source_ko: 2. 당초 건축물 해체신고를 한 경우에는 변경신고를 할 것
rows.text_en: 2. If a building demolition report was originally filed, a change report must be filed.

rows.source_ko: 3. 당초 건축물 해체허가를 받은 경우로서 허가받은 사항의 변경으로 인하여 건축물 해체공사가 법 제30조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 단서에 따라 신고해야 하는 건축물 해체공사에 해당하게 되는 경우에는 제1호에도 불구하고 제2호에 따라 변경신고를 할 것
rows.text_en: 3. In cases where a building demolition permit was originally obtained, and a change in the permitted matters results in the building demolition work falling under the category of building demolition work requiring notification pursuant to the proviso of the part other than each subparagraph of Article 30, Paragraph 1 of the Act, a notification of change shall be filed pursuant to Subparagraph 2, notwithstanding Subparagraph 1.

rows.source_ko: 4. 당초 건축물 해체신고를 한 경우로서 신고한 사항의 변경으로 인하여 건축물 해체공사가 법 제30조제1항 각 호 외의 부분 본문 및 같은 조 제2항에 따라 허가를 받아야 하는 건축물 해체공사에 해당하게 되는 경우에는 제2호에도 불구하고 제1호에 따라 변경허가를 받을 것
rows.text_en: 4. In cases where a building demolition report was originally filed, and a change in the reported matters results in the building demolition work falling under the category of building demolition work requiring a permit pursuant to the main text of the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 30 , Paragraph 1 of the Act and Paragraph 2 of the same Article , a permit for modification shall be obtained pursuant to Subparagraph 1, notwithstanding Subparagraph 2.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따라 변경허가를 신청하거나 변경신고를 하려는 관리자는 별지 제6호의5서식의 건축물 해체 변경허가 신청서 또는 건축물 해체 변경신고서에 변경사항이 반영된 해체계획서를 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Any manager who intends to apply for a permit for change or report a change pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall submit to the permit authority an application for a permit for change of building demolition or a report on a change of building demolition in the form of Annex 6-5 , with a demolition plan reflecting the changes attached.

rows.source_ko: ③ 관리자는 법 제30조의3제2항에 따라 영 제21조의2제5항 각 호의 사항을 변경하려는 경우에는 별지 제6호의6서식의 건축물 해체공사착공 변경신고서에 변경사항을 증명할 수 있는 서류 사본을 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2024. 1. 3.>
rows.text_en: ③ In accordance with Article 30-3, Paragraph 2 of the Act , if the manager intends to change the matters listed in each subparagraph of Article 21-2, Paragraph 5 of the Enforcement Decree, he/she shall submit a Notification of Change in Commencement of Building Demolition Work (Form No. 6-6) to the licensing authority, attaching copies of documents proving the changes. <Amended Jan. 3, 2024>

rows.source_ko: ④ 관리자는 법 제30조의3제3항에 따라 일괄하여 변경신고를 하려는 경우에는 별지 제6호의7서식의 건축물 해체 등 일괄 변경신고서에 변경사항을 증명할 수 있는 서류 사본을 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ④ If the manager intends to file a collective change report pursuant to Article 30-3, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she must submit a collective change report form for building demolition, etc., in Annex 6-7 to the licensing authority, attaching copies of documents proving the changes.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 허가권자는 제1항부터 제4항까지의 규정에 따른 변경허가를 하거나 변경신고를 수리하는 경우에는 다음 각 호의 구분에 따라 관리자에게 변경허가서 또는 확인증을 내주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ When the licensing authority grants a change permit or accepts a change notification pursuant to the provisions of paragraphs 1 through 4, it shall issue a change permit or a confirmation certificate to the manager in accordance with the classifications in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 제1항에 따른 변경허가를 하거나 변경신고를 수리하는 경우: 별지 제6호의8서식의 건축물 해체 변경허가서 또는 건축물 해체 변경신고 확인증
rows.text_en: 1. In cases where a permit for change is granted or a notification of change is accepted pursuant to Paragraph 1: Building Demolition Change Permit or Building Demolition Change Notification Confirmation Certificate in Annex 6-8

rows.source_ko: 2. 제3항에 따른 변경신고를 수리하는 경우: 별지 제6호의9서식의 건축물 해체공사착공 변경신고 확인증
rows.text_en: 2. In the case of accepting the notification of change pursuant to Paragraph 3: Confirmation of Notification of Change for Commencement of Building Demolition Work in Annex 6-9

rows.source_ko: 3. 제4항에 따른 일괄 변경신고를 수리하는 경우: 별지 제6호의9서식의 건축물 해체 등 일괄 변경신고 확인증
rows.text_en: 3. In cases where a bulk change notification is accepted pursuant to Paragraph 4: Confirmation Certificate for Bulk Change Notification of Building Demolition, etc. in Form No. 6-9
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 4, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제12조의4(건축물 해체 현장에 대한 현장점검) ① 법 제30조의4제2항에 따라 허가권자로부터 조치 명령을 받은 자는 필요한 조치의 이행을 완료한 후 별지 제6호의10서식의 조치 명령 이행결과 통보서에 다음 각 호의 자료를 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 12-4 (On-site Inspection of Building Demolition Sites) ① A person who has received an order for measures from the licensing authority pursuant to Article 30-4, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall , after completing the implementation of the necessary measures, submit to the licensing authority the Notification of Results of Implementation of the Order for Measures in Form No. 6-10 of the Appendix, attaching the materials in each of the following subparagraphs.

rows.source_ko: 1. 조치 명령의 이행을 증명할 수 있는 서류 사본
rows.text_en: 1. A copy of documents proving compliance with the action order

rows.source_ko: 2. 현장사진
rows.text_en: 2. On-site photos

rows.source_ko: ② 허가권자는 제1항에 따른 통보를 받은 경우에는 서면점검 또는 현장점검의 방법으로 조치 명령의 이행 사실을 확인해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② Upon receiving the notification pursuant to Paragraph 1, the licensing authority shall verify the compliance with the order to take action through written inspection or on-site inspection.

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제30조의4제4항에 따라 건축물 해체 현장에 대한 현장점검 업무를 대행하는 건축물관리점검기관은 현장점검을 완료한 경우 허가권자에게 별지 제6호의11서식의 건축물 해체 현장 안전점검표를 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In accordance with Article 30-4, Paragraph 4 of the Act , a building management inspection agency acting on behalf of a building demolition site must submit the building demolition site safety inspection checklist in Form No. 6-11 to the licensing authority upon completion of the on-site inspection .
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 4, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제13조(건축물 해체공사감리자의 지정 등) ① 허가권자는 법 제31조제1항에 따라 해체공사감리자를 지정할 때 관리자가 다음 각 호의 요건을 모두 충족하는 사람을 지정해 줄 것을 요청하는 경우에는 그 사람을 우선하여 지정할 수 있다. <개정 2025. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 13 (Designation of Supervisor for Building Demolition Works, etc.) ① When the licensing authority designates a supervisor for demolition work pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 1 of the Act , if the manager requests the designation of a person who satisfies all of the requirements of each of the following subparagraphs, the licensing authority may designate such person with priority. <Amended June 2, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제30조제4항에 따라 해체하려는 건축물(영 제21조제6항 각 호의 건축물과 「건축법 시행령」 제91조의3제1항제1호 및 제5호의 건축물로 한정한다)에 대한 해체계획서를 작성했을 것
rows.text_en: 1. A demolition plan must have been prepared for the building to be demolished pursuant to Article 30, Paragraph 4 of the Act ( limited to buildings under each subparagraph of Article 21, Paragraph 6 of the Enforcement Decree and buildings under Article 91-3, Paragraph 1, Subparagraphs 1 and 5 of the Enforcement Decree of the Building Act).

rows.source_ko: 2. 영 제22조제1항 전단에 따른 명부에 포함되어 있을 것
rows.text_en: 2. Must be included in the register pursuant to the first part of Article 22 , Paragraph 1 of the Enforcement Decree

rows.source_ko: ② 법 제30조제3항에 따라 건축물 해체 허가신청서 또는 신고서를 제출받은 허가권자는 영 제22조제2항 각 호의 건축물에 해당하는 경우에는 법 제31조제1항에 따라 별지 제7호서식의 해체공사감리자 지정통지서를 해당 관리자에게 통지해야 한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: ② In accordance with Article 30, Paragraph 3 of the Act , the licensing authority that has received an application for a building demolition permit or a report shall , in cases where the building falls under any of the subparagraphs of Article 22, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree , notify the relevant manager of the designation notice of the demolition work supervisor in the form of Annex 7 in accordance with Article 31 , Paragraph 1 of the Act. <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: ③ 관리자는 제2항에 따라 지정통지서를 받으면 해당 해체공사감리자와 감리계약을 체결해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ Upon receiving the designation notice pursuant to Paragraph 2, the manager shall enter into a supervision contract with the relevant demolition work supervisor.

rows.source_ko: ④ 관리자가 중앙행정기관의 장, 지방자치단체의 장 및 「공공기관의 운영에 관한 법률」에 따른 공공기관의 장인 경우에 해당 건축물의 해체공사 감리비용은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 방법으로 산정한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: ④ Where the manager is the head of a central administrative agency, the head of a local government, or the head of a public institution pursuant to the Act on the Operation of Public Institutions, the supervision costs for the demolition work of the relevant building shall be calculated by any of the following methods. <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 1. 해체공사비에 국토교통부장관이 정하여 고시하는 요율을 곱하여 산정하는 방법
rows.text_en: 1. A method of calculation by multiplying the demolition cost by the rate determined and notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

rows.source_ko: 2. 「엔지니어링산업 진흥법」 제31조제2항에 따른 엔지니어링사업의 대가 기준 중 실비정액가산방식을 국토교통부장관이 정하여 고시하는 방법에 따라 적용하여 산정하는 방법
rows.text_en: 2. A method of calculation by applying the cost-plus fixed fee method among the fee standards for engineering projects pursuant to Article 31, Paragraph 2 of the Engineering Industry Promotion Act, in accordance with the method prescribed and notified by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport.

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 제4항에 따른 자가 아닌 관리자의 건축물 해체공사 감리비용은 같은 항의 감리비용을 참고하여 정할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The supervision costs for building demolition work by a manager other than the person referred to in Paragraph 4 may be determined by referring to the supervision costs in the same paragraph.

rows.source_ko: 제13조의2(해체공사감리자 등의 교육) ① 해체공사감리 업무를 하려는 해체공사감리자 및 감리원은 법 제31조의2제1항에 따라 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 교육을 각 호에 규정된 시기에 받아야 한다. <개정 2025. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 13-2 (Education for Demolition Work Supervisors, etc.) ① Demolition work supervisors and supervisors who intend to perform demolition work supervision duties shall, in accordance with Article 31-2, Paragraph 1 of the Act , receive education classified under each of the following subparagraphs at the time prescribed in each subparagraph. <Amended June 2, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 신규교육: 해체공사감리자로 지정되거나 감리원으로 배치(제2호에 따라 보수교육을 받아야 하는 시기에 보수교육을 받지 않은 해체공사감리자 및 감리원이 제2호에 따른 시기가 지난 후 해체공사감리자로 지정되거나 감리원으로 배치되려는 경우를 포함한다)되기 전까지
rows.text_en: 1. New Training: Until being designated as a demolition work supervisor or assigned as a supervisor (including cases where a demolition work supervisor or supervisor who has not received refresher training at the time required for refresher training pursuant to Subparagraph 2 intends to be designated as a demolition work supervisor or assigned as a supervisor after the period pursuant to Subparagraph 2 has passed).

rows.source_ko: 2. 보수교육: 신규교육을 받은 날부터 3년마다 받되, 구체적인 이수 시기는 매 3년이 되는 날을 기준일로 하여 그 기준일 1년 전부터 그 기준일까지로 한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Continuing education: Continuing education shall be received every three years from the date of receiving initial education, provided that the specific completion period is set from one year prior to the date marking every three years until the date of the reference date.

rows.source_ko: ② 제1항에 따른 신규교육 및 보수교육의 시간ㆍ내용 및 방법은 다음 각 호와 같다.
rows.text_en: ② The time, content, and method of new training and refresher training pursuant to Paragraph 1 shall be as follows:

rows.source_ko: 1. 교육시간: 다음 각 목의 구분에 따른 시간
rows.text_en: 1. Training Hours: Hours according to the classifications in each of the following items

rows.source_ko: 가. 신규교육: 35시간
rows.text_en: A. New Employee Training: 35 hours

rows.source_ko: 나. 보수교육: 14시간
rows.text_en: B. Continuing Education: 14 hours

rows.source_ko: 2. 교육내용: 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
rows.text_en: 2. Educational Content: The following items must be included.

rows.source_ko: 가. 건축물 해체 관련 법령의 내용
rows.text_en: A. Contents of laws and regulations related to building demolition

rows.source_ko: 나. 건축물 해체공사 현장의 특성
rows.text_en: B. Characteristics of Building Demolition Sites

rows.source_ko: 다. 건축물 해체 시의 구조안전 검토 요령
rows.text_en: C. Guidelines for Structural Safety Review During Building Demolition

rows.source_ko: 라. 감리보고서 작성 방법
rows.text_en: D. Method of Preparing the Supervision Report

rows.text_en: 3. Educational Methods: Group education such as lectures and audiovisual training, on-site training, or distance education using information and communication networks such as the Internet

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제31조의2제2항에 따라 지정받은 해체공사 교육기관은 신규교육 및 보수교육을 이수한 자에게 별지 제7호의2서식의 해체공사 감리교육 이수증을 내주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ A demolition work training institution designated pursuant to Article 31-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall issue a certificate of completion for demolition work supervision training in the form of Annex 7-2 to persons who have completed new training and refresher training.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항부터 제3항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 신규교육 및 보수교육의 구체적인 교육과목, 과목별 교육시간 및 교육생 평가기준 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 국토교통부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ④ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 3, necessary matters concerning specific educational subjects, educational hours per subject, and evaluation criteria for trainees for new education and refresher education shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport .
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 4, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제13조의3(해체공사 교육기관 지정신청서 등) ① 영 제23조의3제3항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 신청서”란 별지 제7호의3서식의 해체공사 교육기관 지정신청서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 13-3 (Application for Designation of Demolition Work Training Institution, etc.) ① In the part other than each subparagraph of Article 23-3, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “application form prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport”refers to the application for designation of a demolition work training institution in Form No. 7-3 of the Appendix .

rows.source_ko: ② 영 제23조의3제4항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 지정서”란 별지 제7호의4서식의 해체공사 교육기관 지정서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ② In Article 23-3, Paragraph 4 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “designation certificate prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the designation certificate for demolition work training institutions in Form No. 7-4 of the Appendix .

rows.source_ko: ③ 법 제31조의2제2항에 따라 지정받은 해체공사 교육기관은 다음 각 호의 서류(전자문서를 포함한다)를 해당 호에 규정된 날까지 국토교통부장관에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ A demolition work training institution designated pursuant to Article 31-2, Paragraph 2 of the Act shall submit the documents (including electronic documents) of each of the following subparagraphs to the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport by the date specified in each subparagraph.

rows.source_ko: 1. 다음 연도의 해체공사 교육기관 운영계획: 매년 10월 31일. 다만, 10월 1일 이후에 지정받은 경우에는 지정받은 날부터 1개월 이내에 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: 1. Operation plan for the demolition work training institution for the following year: October 31 of each year. However, if designated on or after October 1, it must be submitted within one month from the date of designation.

rows.source_ko: 2. 해당 연도의 교육운영 실적: 다음 연도의 1월 31일
rows.text_en: 2. Educational operation performance for the relevant year: January 31 of the following year

rows.source_ko: ④ 제3항에 따라 해체공사 교육기관이 제출해야 하는 운영계획 및 교육운영 실적의 구체적인 내용은 국토교통부장관이 정하여 고시한다.
rows.text_en: ④ The specific details of the operation plan and educational operation performance records that a demolition work training institution must submit pursuant to Paragraph 3 shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport .
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 4, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제14조(해체작업의 시정 또는 중지 등) ① 해체공사감리자는 법 제32조제3항 전단에 따라 보고하는 경우 별지 제8호서식의 건축물 해체작업 시정 또는 중지 요청 보고서에 해체공사감리자 지정통지서 사본을 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14 (Correction or Suspension of Demolition Work, etc.) ① When a demolition work supervisorreports in accordance with the first part of Article 32, Paragraph 3 of the Act , he/she shall submit to the licensing authority a report requesting correction or suspension of building demolition work in Form No. 8 of the Appendix , attaching a copy of the notice of designation of the demolition work supervisor.

rows.source_ko: ② 관리자 또는 해체작업자는 법 제32조제4항에 따라 개선계획을 승인받으려는 경우에는 별지 제9호서식의 해체작업 개선계획서를 허가권자에게 제출해야 한다. <개정 2021. 10. 28.>
rows.text_en: ② If a manager or demolition worker intends to obtain approval for an improvement plan pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 4 of the Act , they shall submit a demolition work improvement plan in the form of Annex 9 to the licensing authority. <Amended Oct. 28, 2021>

rows.source_ko: ③ 허가권자는 제2항에 따라 제출받은 해체작업 개선계획서에 보완이 필요하다고 인정되면 해당 관리자 또는 해체작업자에게 보완을 요청할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ③ If the licensing authority deems that the demolition work improvement plan submitted pursuant to Paragraph 2 requires supplementation, it may request the relevant manager or demolition worker to supplement it.

rows.source_ko: 제14조의2(사진 및 동영상의 촬영ㆍ보관 등) ① 해체공사감리자는 법 제32조제5항에 따라 사진 및 동영상(이하 이 조에서 “사진등”이라 한다)을 촬영하는 때에는 불가피한 경우를 제외하고는 촬영 대상 공정별로 같은 장소에서 촬영해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 14-2 (Taking and storing photos and videos, etc.) ① When a demolition work supervisor takes photos and videos (hereinafter referred to as “photos, etc.” in this Article) pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 5 of the Act, they must take the photos at the same location for each process subject to filming, except in cases where it is unavoidable.

rows.source_ko: ② 해체공사감리자는 제1항에 따라 촬영한 사진등을 디지털파일 형태로 가공ㆍ처리한 후 해체공사 공정별로 구분하여 관리자가 법 제33조제1항에 따라 건축물 해체공사 완료신고를 한 날부터 30일까지 보관해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② The demolition work supervisor shall process and handle the photographs, etc. taken pursuant to Paragraph 1 into digital file form, classify them by demolition work process, and keep them for 30 days from the date the manager reports the completion of the building demolition work pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act .

rows.source_ko: ③ 해체공사감리자는 허가권자 및 관리자가 해체공사 현장의 안전관리 현황 등을 확인하기 위하여 제2항에 따른 기간에 보관 중인 사진등의 제공을 요청하는 경우에는 사진등을 제공해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The demolition work supervisor shall provide photographs, etc. stored during the period specified in Paragraph 2 if the licensing authority and manager request the provision of such photographs, etc., in order to verify the safety management status of the demolition work site.
[This Article Newly Inserted Aug. 4, 2022]

rows.source_ko: 제15조(해체감리완료보고서) 해체공사감리자는 법 제32조제8항에 따라 해체감리완료보고서를 작성하는 경우 감리업무 수행 내용ㆍ결과 및 해체공사 결과 등을 포함하여 작성해야 한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4.>
rows.text_en: Article 15 (Report on Completion of Demolition Supervision) When a demolition work supervisor prepares a report on completion of demolition supervision pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 8 of the Act , the report shall include the details and results of the performance of supervision duties and the results of the demolition work, etc. <Amended Aug. 4, 2022>

rows.source_ko: 제16조(건축물 해체공사 완료신고) ① 관리자는 법 제33조제1항에 따라 건축물 해체공사 완료신고를 하려는 경우 별지 제10호서식의 건축물 해체공사 완료신고서에 다음 각 호의 서류를 첨부하여 허가권자에게 제출(전자문서로 제출하는 것을 포함한다)해야 한다. <개정 2022. 8. 4., 2025. 6. 2.>
rows.text_en: Article 16 (Report on Completion of Building Demolition Work) ① When a managerintends to report the completion of building demolition work pursuant to Article 33, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall submit the Building Demolition Work Completion Report Form (Form No. 10 ) to the licensing authority, attaching the documents specified in each of the following subparagraphs (including submission as an electronic document). <Amended Aug. 4, 2022; Jun. 2, 2025>

rows.source_ko: 1. 법 제32조제8항에 따라 제출받은 해체감리완료보고서
rows.text_en: 1. Report on the completion of dismantling supervision received pursuant to Article 32, Paragraph 8 of the Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 건설폐기물 처리 세금계산서, 건설폐기물 처리업체에서 발급한 처리 확인서 등 건설폐기물 반출 실적을 증명할 수 있는 서류
rows.text_en: 2. Documents proving the performance of construction waste removal, such as tax invoices for construction waste disposal and disposal confirmation certificates issued by construction waste disposal companies

rows.source_ko: ② 허가권자는 제1항에 따라 신고서를 제출받은 경우 건축물 또는 건축물 자재에 석면이 함유되었는지를 확인해야 한다. 이 경우 석면 함유에 대한 통보에 관하여는 영 제21조제3항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the licensing authority receives a report pursuant to Paragraph 1, it shall verify whether the building or building materials contain asbestos. In this case , Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall apply mutatis mutandis to the notification of asbestos content .

rows.source_ko: ③ 허가권자는 제1항에 따라 건축물 해체공사 완료신고서를 제출받았을 때에는 석면 함유 여부 및 건축물의 해체공사 완료 여부를 확인한 후 별지 제11호서식의 건축물 해체공사 완료 신고확인증을 신고인에게 내주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the licensing authority receives a report on the completion of building demolition work pursuant to Paragraph 1, it shall verify whether the building contains asbestos and whether the demolition work has been completed, and then issue a certificate of completion of building demolition work in the form of Annex 11 to the reporter.

rows.source_ko: 제17조(건축물 멸실의 신고) ① 관리자는 법 제34조제1항 본문에 따라 멸실신고를 하려는 경우에는 별지 제10호서식의 건축물 멸실 신고서를 허가권자에게 제출(전자문서로 제출하는 것을 포함한다)해야 한다.
rows.text_en: Article 17 (Report of Destruction of Building) ① If a managerintends to report destruction pursuant to the main text of Article 34, Paragraph 1 of the Act , he/she shall submit a report of destruction of a building in the form of Annex 10 to the licensing authority (including submission as an electronic document).

rows.source_ko: ② 허가권자는 제1항에 따라 신고서를 제출받은 경우 건축물 또는 건축물 자재에 석면이 함유되었는지를 확인해야 한다. 이 경우 석면 함유에 대한 통보에 관하여는 영 제21조제3항을 준용한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the licensing authority receives a report pursuant to Paragraph 1, it shall verify whether the building or building materials contain asbestos. In this case , Article 21, Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree shall apply mutatis mutandis to the notification of asbestos content .

rows.source_ko: ③ 허가권자는 제1항에 따라 건축물 멸실 신고서를 제출받았을 때에는 석면 함유 여부 및 신고 내용을 확인한 후 별지 제11호서식의 건축물 멸실 신고확인증을 신고인에게 내주어야 한다.
rows.text_en: ③ When the licensing authority receives a report of building destruction pursuant to Paragraph 1, it shall verify whether asbestos is contained and the contents of the report, and then issue a certificate of building destruction report in the form of Annex 11 to the reporter.

rows.source_ko: 제5장 건축물관리 지원 등
rows.text_en: Chapter 5 Support for Building Management, etc.

rows.source_ko: 제18조(국제 교류 및 협력) 법 제38조제5호에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 사항”이란 다음 각 호의 사항을 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 18 (International Exchange and Cooperation) The term “matters prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” in Article 38, subparagraph 5 of the Act refers to the following matters:

rows.source_ko: 1. 외국 정부기관과의 정기적 협력회의 개최
rows.text_en: 1. Holding regular cooperation meetings with foreign government agencies

rows.source_ko: 2. 해외진출에 필요한 건축물관리기술 개발의 수요조사
rows.text_en: 2. Demand Survey for the Development of Building Management Technology Necessary for Overseas Expansion

rows.source_ko: 제19조(건축물관리지원센터의 지정) ① 영 제29조제2항 각 호 외의 부분에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 신청서”란 별지 제12호서식의 건축물관리지원센터 지정신청서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: Article 19 (Designation of Building Management Support Center) ① In the part other than each subparagraph of Article 29, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree , the term “application form prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport”refers to the application form for designation of a Building Management Support Center in Form No. 12 of the Appendix.

rows.source_ko: ② 국토교통부장관은 영 제29조제2항 및 이 조 제1항에 따라 신청서를 제출받은 경우 「전자정부법」 제36조제1항에 따른 행정정보의 공동이용을 통해 법인 등기사항증명서(법인인 경우만 해당한다) 또는 사업자등록증명을 확인해야 한다. 이 경우 신청인이 사업자등록증명 확인에 동의하지 않은 경우에는 해당 서류를 제출하도록 해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ② When the Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transport receives an application pursuant to Article 29, Paragraph 2 of the Enforcement Decree and Paragraph 1 of this Article, he / she shall verify the Certificate of Corporate Registration (only applicable to corporations) or the Certificate of Business Registration through the joint use of administrative information pursuant to Article 36, Paragraph 1 of the Electronic Government Act. In this case, if the applicant does not consent to the verification of the Certificate of Business Registration, the applicant shall be required to submit the relevant document.

rows.source_ko: ③ 영 제29조제3항에서 “국토교통부령으로 정하는 지정서”란 별지 제13호서식의 건축물관리지원센터 지정서를 말한다.
rows.text_en: ③ In Article 29 , Paragraph 3 of the Enforcement Decree, the term “designation certificate prescribed by the Ordinance of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport” refers to the Building Management Support Center Designation Certificate in Form No. 13 of the Appendix .

rows.source_ko: 제20조(지역건축물관리지원센터의 설치 및 운영 등) ① 법 제40조제2항에 따른 지역건축물관리지원센터(이하 “지역건축물관리지원센터”라 한다)에는 센터장 1명과 기술지원, 정보제공 및 안전대책의 수립 등에 필요한 전문인력을 둔다.
rows.text_en: Article 20 (Establishment and Operation of Regional Building Management Support Center, etc.) ① The Regional Building Management Support Center pursuant to Article 40, Paragraph 2 of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Regional Building Management Support Center”) shall have one Center Director and professional personnel necessary for technical support, provision of information, and establishment of safety measures, etc.

rows.source_ko: ② 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 해당 지방자치단체 소속 공무원 중에서 건축물관리에 관한 학식과 경험이 풍부한 사람으로 하여금 제1항에 따른 센터장(이하 “센터장”이라 한다)을 겸임하게 할 수 있다.
rows.text_en: ② The Mayor of a Special Self-Governing City, the Governor of a Special Self-Governing Province, or the Mayor, County Governor, or District Head may have a person with extensive knowledge and experience in building management among the public officials belonging to the relevant local government concurrently serve as the Center Director pursuant to Paragraph 1 (hereinafter referred to as the “Center Director”).

rows.source_ko: ③ 센터장은 지역건축물관리지원센터의 사무를 총괄하고, 소속 직원을 지휘ㆍ감독한다.
rows.text_en: ③ The Center Director oversees the affairs of the Regional Building Management Support Center and directs and supervises the staff.

rows.source_ko: ④ 제1항에 따른 전문인력은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 자격을 갖춘 사람으로서 건축물관리에 관한 학식과 경험이 풍부한 사람으로 한다. <개정 2021. 12. 10.>
rows.text_en: ④ The professional personnel referred to in Paragraph 1 shall be persons who possess qualifications falling under any of the following subparagraphs and who have extensive knowledge and experience in building management. <Amended Dec. 10, 2021>

rows.source_ko: 1. 「건축사법」 제2조제1호에 따른 건축사
rows.text_en: 1. An architect pursuant to Article 2, Subparagraph 1 of the Architects Act

rows.source_ko: 2. 「국가기술자격법」에 따른 건축구조기술사
rows.text_en: 2. Architectural Structural Engineer under the National Technical Qualifications Act

rows.source_ko: 3. 「국가기술자격법」에 따른 건축시공기술사
rows.text_en: 3. Professional Engineer in Architectural Construction under the National Technical Qualifications Act

rows.source_ko: 4. 「국가기술자격법」에 따른 건설안전기술사
rows.text_en: 4. Professional Engineer in Construction Safety under the National Technical Qualifications Act

rows.source_ko: 5. 「건설기술 진흥법 시행령」 별표 1에 따른 건축구조 전문분야의 특급건설기술인 또는 고급건설기술인
rows.text_en: 5. Special Grade Construction Engineer or Senior Grade Construction Engineer in the specialized field of architectural structures pursuant to Annex 1 of the Enforcement Decree of the Construction Technology Promotion Act

rows.source_ko: ⑤ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 제4항제1호에 해당하는 전문인력 1명 이상과 같은 항 제2호 또는 제5호에 해당하는 전문인력 1명 이상을 두어야 하며, 지역건축물관리지원센터의 전문인력을 확보하기 위하여 노력해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑤ The mayor of a special self-governing city, the governor of a special self-governing province, or the mayor, county head, or district head shall employ at least one professional staff member corresponding to subparagraph 1 of paragraph 4 and at least one professional staff member corresponding to subparagraph 2 or 5 of the same paragraph, and shall endeavor to secure professional staff for the regional building management support center.

rows.source_ko: ⑥ 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 지역의 규모ㆍ예산ㆍ인력 등을 고려할 때 단독으로 지역건축물관리지원센터를 설치ㆍ운영하는 것이 어려운 경우에는 둘 이상의 특별자치시ㆍ특별자치도 또는 시ㆍ군ㆍ자치구가 공동으로 하나의 지역건축물관리지원센터를 설치ㆍ운영할 수 있다. 이 경우 공동으로 지역건축물관리지원센터를 설치ㆍ운영하려는 특별자치시장ㆍ특별자치도지사 또는 시장ㆍ군수ㆍ구청장은 지역건축물관리지원센터의 공동 설치 및 운영에 관한 협약을 체결해야 한다.
rows.text_en: ⑥ If it is difficult for a Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or Mayor, County Head, or District Head to establish and operate a Regional Building Management Support Center independently considering the scale, budget, and personnel of the region, two or more Special Self-Governing Cities, Special Self-Governing Provinces, or Cities, Countys, or Autonomous Districts may jointly establish and operate a single Regional Building Management Support Center. In this case, the Special Self-Governing City Mayor, Special Self-Governing Province Governor, or Mayor, County Head, or District Head who intend to jointly establish and operate the Regional Building Management Support Center must enter into an agreement regarding the joint establishment and operation of the Regional Building Management Support Center.

rows.source_ko: ⑦ 제1항부터 제6항까지에서 규정한 사항 외에 지역건축물관리지원센터의 조직 및 운영 등에 필요한 사항은 해당 지방자치단체의 조례로 정한다.
rows.text_en: ⑦ In addition to the matters prescribed in paragraphs 1 through 6, matters necessary for the organization and operation, etc. of the Regional Building Management Support Center shall be determined by the ordinance of the relevant local government .

rows.text_en: Article 22 (Disaster Prevention of Public Buildings) ① The Minister of Land, Infrastructure and Transportmay require the manager of a public building falling under any of the following subparagraphs to improve its performance pursuant to Article 44, Paragraph 1 of the Act .
